title: Lebanon goods exports and imports by partner country, 1995-2024 (BACI)
source: CEPII BACI, HS92 edition, version 202601 (Gaulier and Zignago, 2010); Lebanon (code 422) as exporter or importer
license: Etalab Open Licence 2.0 (any use allowed if the source is mentioned; BACI/CEPII named on the CEPII BACI page)
citation: Gaulier, G. and Zignago, S. (2010) BACI: International Trade Database at the Product-Level. CEPII Working Paper 2010-23.
note: Reconciled mirror data: exports are Lebanon-to-partner flows as reconciled across both reporters, so they differ from Lebanese Customs and from WDI balance-of-payments figures. Values in current US$ (BACI publishes thousand US$; multiplied by 1000), quantities in tonnes where given (0 means not reported).
